content: An eye for an eye will only make the whole world blind. Embrace criticism as a tool for self-improvement and transform challenges into opportunities.
If you fail, never give up because FAIL means ‘First Attempt In Learning.’ Use feedback to innovate and push boundaries.
I don’t believe in taking right decisions. I take decisions and then make them right. Listening to feedback can guide you in making adaptable and informed choices.
Talk to yourself once in a day, otherwise you may miss meeting an intelligent person in this world. Regular self-reflection is key to acting on constructive feedback.
